name: clean-development
description: Machine storage routing, session-end cleanup and dot-folder policy for G's Mac (Claude Code, Codex, claude-1..5).

scripts.check: for f in installer.mjs runtime/lib/*.mjs runtime/bin/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node scripts/check-release.mjs && zsh -n machine/env.zsh && bash -n machine/env.zsh && sh -n runtime/bin/cd-hook && sh -n install.sh && sh -n remove-legacy.sh
